Description:
std::uint16_t member variable which represents the used IEEE1722 defined AVTP stream data
subtype header field.
The following AVTP stream data subtypes shall be supported:
0x00 (61883_IIDC)
0x02 (AAF)
0x04 (CRF)
0x05 (TSCF)
0x07 (RVF)
0x82 (NTSCF)
